CDS Protocol N - Wound Care

Protocol cds protocol wound care

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Wound care protocol using CDS for infection support and healing facilitation.

Indications

  • Wound care
  • Infection support
  • Healing facilitation
  • Wound healing

Steps

  1. Prepare wound care dose
  2. Follow care protocol
  3. Monitor wound status
  4. Track healing
  5. Watch for signs of infection

Dosage

Wound care protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Wound healing
  • Infection resolution
  • Tissue repair
  • Healing support

Monitoring

  • Monitor wound healing
  • Track infection status
  • Watch for complications
  • Medical supervision for serious wounds

Frequency: 2 times daily
